name: support-routing
description: Route a customer message to a team, with an explicit escape option for inputs that have no right answer (live demo 2026-09-22: without it, off-topic text got near-certain wrong answers). Small illustrative set: n is too low for a verdict; use it to learn the kit.

dept.instructions: Which support team should handle this customer message?

criteria.sales: Pricing questions, plans, buying more seats
criteria.none: Not a customer support request at all: empty, noise, or unrelated to our product

urgent.instructions: Does the message say the problem is blocking work or costing money right now?
